name: Modern M2
description: Loads models authored for newer versions of the game (MD21, inner versions 272-274) natively: the container is read in place, records are normalized to the client's shapes, textures resolve by FileDataID, over-budget submeshes are split, and modern shader ids are decoded into the client's material contract. x64 port of manatactical/wxl-modern-m2 (7f793b1).
